text.description_html:
Acorn IMABP, 8-1/3" Iron Art Tuscan Front Door Knocker

From top to bottom, the Extra Large Tuscan Handmade Iron Art Door Knocker measures 8-1/3 inches, which may seem small, but trust us when we say that this is a big piece, perfect for large doors. Hand forged, the Tuscan Iron Door Knocker is a modern day reminder of the times of old. Brilliantly hand crafted, this ring door knocker made by Acorn, will be sure to add a historic feel to any door. It may look like it comes straight from another century, but it is made to last; it has a lifetime no rust warranty. The uneven surface of this iron piece duplicates that found on the ironwork of many European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron.

Specifications of the Tuscan Hand Forged Door Knocker:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 8-1/3"
  • Width: 6-3/4"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Includes 5/8" Knocker Nail
  • Surface mounted. Comes with mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Due to the handmade nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
